_why: Country rules from the pre-launch legal review (2026-11-04). forecast:false = no model forecast, no UV forecast, no 'best hours' (a local forecasting licence is required); weather:false = no weather at all; quakes:false = no earthquake list; monitors_only = only government reference monitors are shown.

JP.note: 気象業務法 17条 予報業務許可; JMA forecasts are relayed as issued

TW.note: 氣象法: forecasts need a CWA permit

VN.note: Law on Hydro-Meteorology: forecasting needs a licence

ID.note: UU 31/2009 §36: public MKG information services are BMKG's

SA.note: Meteorology law §3: NCM licence for any weather publication

KR.note: 지진관측법 §16: only KMA announces quake observations

TR.note: MGM law §27: private station readings need MGM permission
